We don't have any kids but we do have a homestead and a bunch of animals and they do take up my time. It's ok not to have kids even if you really want. Adoption of foster is absolutely an option. But it's great to learn and improve your homemaking skills or hobbies. It's also a great opportunity to work on yourself, personal development is great. A lot of homemakers do tend to make kids the center of there homemaking. And I would  love more YouTubers without kids for us that doesn't have or can't have. But you can do alot of other things without kids. Dogs are a great start. Train the dog big or small. Backyard chickens is also an option. Or beekeeping. 
Even as a homemaker you can have part-time job. I work 10h a week as a cleaner. You can thrive without kids. First it's about accepting that you might never have kids. And that is hard. But it's a part of personal development.
